summary: TradeOS Mobile Experience v1.0 — re-verified at 390x844 (iPhone 12 Pro) after AppLayout overflow-x-hidden and ProductionLibrary mobile-card fixes. HORIZONTAL SCROLL IS NOW ELIMINATED on all 8 pages tested (Command Center, Projects, Estimating, Settings, Opportunities, Financial, Expenses, Documents — all report document.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). Production Library correctly renders 367 mobile cards on <lg and no desktop table is visible. Hamburger menu at [data-testid='mobile-menu-btn'] is 48x48, opens a full-height drawer with backdrop, all drawer nav items are ≥44px. New Project CTA is now 44px. However, TOUCH TARGET SIZE remains a partial failure: several buttons across the app are still under the 44px minimum: Command Center opportunity-row buttons (40px), Production Library workspace hamburger (40x40) + command-palette (40x42), Settings edit-profile-btn (20x46), Upgrade to Pro/Elite buttons (40px), save-labor-rate-btn (32px). Login flow works. Post-login /api/command-center and /api/workspace/context still throw 'Failed to fetch' (pre-existing since iteration_26).

action_items: PRIMARY: Enforce min-h-[44px] on all button elements across CommandCenter (opportunity-row-*), Settings (edit-profile-btn, upgrade buttons, save-labor-rate-btn, icon buttons), ProductionLibraryWorkspace (workspace hamburger ~line 2352 w-10 h-10 -> w-11 h-11 or w-12 h-12; open-command-palette same treatment), Company Brain popover (brain-submit), and Projects modal 'Create Project' submit.
SECONDARY: Consider a global CSS rule in responsive.css scoped to @media (max-width: 1024px) that sets `button:not(.no-touch-min) { min-height: 44px }` to prevent regression on future buttons.

TERTIARY: Investigate persistent 'Failed to fetch' on /api/command-center and /api/workspace/context that has now been reported for 3 iterations (26, 27, 28). Likely a CORS/preflight or race with Supabase session hydration.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx is still 2433 lines — still >3x the 700-line guideline. Splitting is still overdue.

The overflow-x-hidden approach on <main> and its inner wrapper (AppLayout.jsx lines 246 + 262) is a valid safety net, but the underlying flex-child min-w-0 issue was NOT fixed structurally at line 204 (<div className='flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-screen'>). Adding 'min-w-0' there is still recommended as a defensive fix so future wide children don't rely on the ancestor's overflow-x-hidden to hide the bug. Currently users may lose scroll access to content that WOULD have overflowed instead of visibly failing — silent clipping is not ideal for tables/reports.

Touch-target compliance is inconsistent — some spots use min-h-[44px] or min-h-[48px] correctly, others hardcode h-10 (40px) or h-8 (32px). Recommend a shared Button primitive with size='mobile' variant to standardise.

success_rate.frontend: 8/9 features PASS, 1 PARTIAL (touch-target minimum only met on primary CTAs — many secondary buttons still <44px)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 review-request items were tested at 390x844. The single previously-blocking horizontal-scroll bug on /app/estimating (iteration_27) is now RESOLVED — Production Library renders 367 mobile cards, docSW==clientWidth==390. The remaining work is purely a touch-target-size audit — enumerate button.getBoundingClientRect() heights and enforce >=44 on mobile. See action_items[0] for the specific selectors that still miss.
rca of the issue: Iteration 27 horizontal-scroll on Estimating was caused by (a) missing min-w-0 on AppLayout flex-child + (b) fixed-width list columns totalling ~900px. The main agent fixed it by (1) adding overflow-x-hidden on <main> and its inner div in AppLayout.jsx (lines 246+262) AND (2) implementing a fully separate mobile card view in ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx (lg:hidden block at line 899, wrapping 367 [data-testid='standard-mobile-card-*'] cards) and hiding the table with hidden lg:block at line 959. This resolves the visible bug. The still-open touch-target items are independent — they are per-component hardcoded heights (h-10, h-8) that were never migrated to min-h-[44px].
